scripts.build: export PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) && export PATH=$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH && observable build
scripts.dev: export PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) && export PATH=$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH && observable preview
scripts.deploy: export PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) && export PATH=$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH && observable deploy
scripts.preinstall: pip install uv --upgrade && pip uninstall opencv-python
